deadline.value: The international fall deadline is April 15; the domestic deadline is July 15.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The admissions page does not say whether a faculty agreement is needed before admission.

funding.value: The page does not state whether all admitted PhD students are funded.

entry_route.value: The page does not state whether a master's degree is needed.

gre_general.value: GRE is not required, but it is recommended.
gre_general.quote: GRE is not required, but it is recommended.

fee_waiver.value: A waiver is available only to applicants with a US BS or MS and a GPA of 3.5 or higher; MS applicants and non-CS degree holders cannot get one.
fee_waiver.quote: Students who have completed BS or MS degrees at a US college or university with a GPA of 3.5 or higher are eligible for applying for an application fee waiver.

also.quote: MS students and students who do not have a CS degree are not eligible for an application fee waiver.

notes: The data science page on the same site covers a master's degree only; no data science PhD was found.
